summary: Master the SAFe Framework for program management. Our training equips you with the tools to scale Agile practices and enhance team collaboration.
lede: Scaled Agile program management training is for Agile delivery professionals coordinating work across teams, programs, and portfolios. Learners practice Program Increment planning, Agile Release Train coordination, dependency mapping, WSJF prioritization, and Lean portfolio Kanban. They also interpret flow metrics and build program dashboards to report execution and Program Increment outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in Agile delivery environments and need to coordinate work across teams, programs, and portfolios using SAFe practices. Program Managers coordinating multiple Agile teams and dependency paths. Release Train Engineers facilitating PI planning and ART cadence. Agile Coaches supporting scaled ceremonies and working agreements. Portfolio Managers shaping Lean budgeting and portfolio Kanban flow. PMO Leads translating governance requirements into Agile reporting. Scrum Masters managing iteration dependencies inside an ART. Product Managers aligning features to PI objectives and value streams. Solution Train Engineers handling large-solution coordination, where applicable. Business Analysts refining features, enablers, and acceptance criteria. Transformation Leads overseeing enterprise Agile adoption and reporting.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, and be ready to work with a sample program, portfolio, or value stream from your organization. Prior experience with Agile ceremonies, backlog management, or project reporting will help you complete the exercises more effectively.
